Bill.BriefDescription: Logging the telephone calls of residents of the special commitment center.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to logging the telephone calls of residents of thespecial commitment center; adding a new section to chapter 71.09 RCW;adding a new section to chapter 42.56 RCW; and creating new sections.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds and declares that thespecial commitment center increases public safety by providingtreatment in a secure environment to civilly committed sexually violentpredators. The legislature further finds that the residents of thespecial commitment center may make harassing telephone calls to personsin the community with no record of the call being made, which runscounter to the center's goals of public safety and treatment. It istherefore the intent of the legislature to increase public safety andimprove treatment in the special commitment center.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 71.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall maintain a log of phone calls made byresidents of the special commitment center. The log shall indicate thedate and time when each phone call was made, the length of the call, p. 1 SHB 2756the name of the resident who made the call, and the number called. Thedepartment may contract with a private organization to maintain thelog.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.56 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Logs of telephone calls made by residents of the special commitmentcenter maintained under section 2 of this act are exempt from publicinspection and copying under this chapter.
If specific funding for the purposes of thisact, referencing this act by bill or chapter number, is not provided byJune 30, 2008, in the omnibus appropriations act, this act is null andvoid.
